I will start by testing an inverse-error weighted combination of the top-ranked models, which are primarily frequency-domain boosted trees that have shown superior performance in recent windows. This leverages the "weighted" hint while focusing on the most robust performers to mitigate high variance from weight estimation.

I will test a broader combination using `pool_full` to include potentially complementary models from different correlation groups, weighted by `inverse_error`, to see if capturing more diversity improves robustness against the trend dominance.

action_args.rationale: Testing broad pool with inverse error weights to leverage diversity against moderate ranking stability.
